'''Mytus VI''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mytus system's star|Mytus]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was unoccupied, being barren and inhospitable to [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] life. Mytus VI was the planet assigned to [[Torm Dadeferron]] during [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] scheme to determine [[Rekkon]]'s assassin.
